name: Downtown Disney Salt & Straw Dairy-Free Coconut/Oat Flavors or Double Fold Vanilla (With Lactase)
brandOrRestaurant: Salt & Straw Scoop Shop (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
searchKeywords: dairy free ice cream downtown disney
whyItWorks: Salt & Straw always keeps 20% of its menu 100% Vegan/Dairy-Free (made with coconut cream or oat milk) and offers Kids'/Single Split Scoops so you can enjoy a small portion without lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to sample the current non-citrus, nut-free Dairy-Free Coconut/Oat flavor (or order a Kids' scoop of Double Fold Vanilla / Sea Salt Caramel with 2 lactase tablets).
watchOuts: Avoid flavors with black pepper, habanero, citrus curd, or whole brittle nuts
